items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclppIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--360f18fc9e47e86d18dfae3ad5c4f773b706749f/0.png) This competition takes place on a **Thursday Evening** and will only feature 3x3x3 One-Handed and 4x4x4 Cube. Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. All attendees under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a chaperone any time they are not in the competition room per Ohio Union policy, regardless of whether they are a competitor or guest.
